capabilities: Generate quiz questions from notes in chosen scope folders using an LLM
Quiz with multiple choice, true/false, multiple select, fill-in-the-blank, ordering, and cloze questions
Schedule reviews offline with FSRS spaced repetition
Track knowledge per concept and rotate question variants
Store question banks and review logs as markdown and JSON files in the vault
extras: The API key is stored in plaintext in data.json and syncs with the vault; note content from scope folders is sent to the configured LLM provider when updating questions, while reviewing is fully local and offline. The plugin ships with no API key and the user pays for their own.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn existing notes into adaptive active-recall quizzes; users would have to write flashcards and schedule reviews themselves.
